sections.text:
Juha was on the top floor of his house, when he heard a knock on the outside door.

He looked out the window and saw a strange man standing below.

Juha asked him: “Who are you and what do you want?”

The man said: “Come down to me, sir, so I will tell you.”

Juha went down the long stairs and opened the door. He asked him: “What’s the matter?”

The man said: “I am a poor questioner. Is there any good deed for God?”

Juha was angry because the man made him go down all the stairs and did not inform him of his request while he was upstairs, but he suppressed his anger and said: “Come upstairs with me.”

The questioner went up behind Juha until they reached the upper floor. Juha turned to him and said calmly: “May God give you!”

The questioner got angry and said: “Why didn’t you tell me that while I was downstairs?!”

Juha replied: “Why didn’t you tell me your request while you were downstairs and let me come down to you?”
The lesson: Treat people the way they treat you.
